solutions.explanation:
By definition, \(\log_{10}9\) is the exponent to which \(10\) must be raised to obtain \(9\). The logarithm is defined because its argument is positive and its base is positive and different from \(1\). Therefore
\[
10^{\log_{10}9}=9.
\]
The given equation becomes \(8x+5=9\). Subtracting \(5\) and dividing by \(8\) gives
\[
x=\frac{9-5}{8}=\frac12.
\]
The answer is \(\frac12\), choice \(\mathrm{B}\).
solutions.title: Use the meaning of the logarithm
